title: No Support of Sony Smartwatch 3 SW50 since latest DEV (2.8.2) version
symptom: The user reports that after updating to AAPS 2.8.2 DEV, the Sony Smartwatch 3 SW50 is no longer updated. Installing the wear.apk via ADB fails, whereas it worked with the 2.8.2 master version.
evidence_quote: After creating 2.8.2 DEV in Android studio and installing it on the smartphone the watch isn't updated anymore. So I tried to deploy the newest 2.8.2 watch.APK via ADB to the smartwatch without luck. The installing process cannot be done anymore.
